stories.headline: Israelis turn out in record numbers as Netanyahu faces a tight election
stories.summary: Turnout hit its highest level in more than two decades in a tense vote on whether to keep Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition in power.

stories.headline: Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 patients
stories.summary: The record-breaking outbreak, first identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now reached 10,000 patients and is spreading quickly.

stories.headline: Southwest flood damage runs to hundreds of millions in New Mexico alone
stories.summary: Intense El Niño-linked rainstorms have caused severe flooding across the Southwest, including southwestern Colorado, with New Mexico's damage estimates already in the hundreds of millions of dollars.

stories.headline: Emails show how schools handled reported racist incidents at Colorado football games
stories.summary: Records shed light on how schools, including Parker's Lutheran High School, which CHSAA put on probation nearly two weeks ago, responded to reports of racist conduct at games.

stories.headline: No. 8 MSU men's soccer blanks Green Bay 3-0 to close non-conference play
stories.summary: The Spartans shut out the Phoenix on Tuesday in their final non-conference match of the season.

fear_greed.commentary: The index sits in fear at 34, little changed from the prior close of 34 but up from 30 a week ago and 32 a month ago.

markets.summary: Chipmakers led stocks to a second straight gain Tuesday as the Fed opened its two-day meeting: the S&P 500 rose 0.60% to 7,722.60, the Nasdaq jumped 1.18% to 26,477.81 and the Dow was nearly flat, up 0.03% to 52,377.57, while the chip index climbed about 3.6%. Small caps joined in, with the Russell 2000 up 1.16% to 2,818.87, back above its 40-week average. The 10-year Treasury yield held near 4.99% as October consumer confidence jumped to 91.7, well above forecasts, and futures still price only about a 9% chance of a hike Wednesday but roughly 83% for December. Gold futures rose 0.9% to $4,074.60 as oil slid on Iran diplomacy headlines, and silver recovered from an 11-month overnight low to finish up 0.3% at $54.29; both remain below their 40-week averages.

stories.headline: Nvidia to invest $3 billion in Meta's stock sale as the two expand their AI partnership
stories.summary: Meta will deploy more Vera Rubin systems, Vera CPUs and Spectrum-X networking for its Muse models and agents, and Nvidia will put $3 billion into Meta's equity offering.

stories.headline: Oracle expands Nvidia chip deal to multi-gigawatt scale while adding Google TPUs
stories.summary: Oracle will scale up Nvidia Vera Rubin servers but will use its own networking chips and begin offering Google TPUs and Cerebras systems, diversifying away from Nvidia.

stories.headline: SpaceX rises on Anthropic's $120.5 billion compute deal and a Deutsche Bank target hike
stories.summary: Anthropic said it will pay SpaceX up to $120.5 billion for AI computing through 2029, and Deutsche Bank lifted its price target to $250 from $235.

stories.headline: BofA adds SpaceX to its top-picks list; Bernstein raises target to $268
stories.summary: BofA put SPCX on its US 1 List and estimated about $6 billion of equipment spending for a Starlink cell-tower buildout, while Bernstein raised its target citing AI compute and connectivity growth.

stories.headline: Cameco jumps 4% ahead of Friday's third-quarter report
stories.summary: CCJ closed at $82.41, still about 39% below its 52-week high, as uranium peers rallied; Cameco reports Q3 results before the open Oct. 30.

headlines.headline: S&P 500 posts back-to-back gains as chips rally and oil slides
headlines.summary: Stocks rose as traders piled back into chipmakers, parsed a heavy slate of earnings and watched oil fall as the Fed began its two-day policy meeting.

headlines.headline: Gold breaks a four-day ceiling as oil slips; consumer confidence beats
headlines.summary: Spot gold closed up 1.1% near $4,060 after October consumer confidence jumped to 91.7 against an 81.2 forecast and September new home sales topped estimates.

breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 502 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Oct. 27 close (mimics MMFI).

weather.summary: Repeated rounds of valley rain and mountain snow keep the Northwest and northern Rockies unsettled through Thursday, with slick travel over the passes, while the Great Basin, California and the Southwest stay dry. Prolonged coastal flooding, beach erosion and dangerous rip currents persist along the Southeast and Florida Atlantic coasts through Wednesday, and dry, breezy air raises fire danger inland. Unseasonable warmth 10 to 20 degrees above normal spreads from the Plains to the Great Lakes, near record by Wednesday, with scattered showers and storms crossing the Upper Midwest Wednesday night and moisture from Vance's remnants reaching Texas late Thursday.
